units.name: Force -O2 on GCC + AVX2, document split load
units.evidence: The actual change is a GCC-only #pragma GCC optimize("-O2") for AVX2. It is guarded by !defined(__clang__), and this Alive2 workflow requires Clang-generated LLVM IR, so the changed compiler mode cannot be represented by the checker.

notes: GCC-only optimizer pragma has no Clang/LLVM IR representation under this Alive2 pipeline.
